comments.body: Does it mean to remove "jcr:uuid" in https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/87db499bd2e820b51a82103067f286324c0b6547/fcrepo-kernel/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/kernel/FedoraJcrTypes.java ?
It does, as well as to see to it that no "fedora:uuid" triples are emitted at any endpoint, insofar as it is possible to test that.
PR: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/807
See comments to https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/807
Does anyone know where does the triple create?

As I commented in the linked PR:

"No, you need to make sure that the triple in question actually stops being published. I don't know where it is created, but it's probably somewhere near PropertiesRdfContext."
I already saw your commented in PR. Since you didn't know, so I expect someone in the Fedora community know the actual location.
Perhaps, but I think it more likely that discovering that location will be part of the work of this ticket.
If really no one in Fedora community know the actually location, I would like to discover that. Since most committers were at OR last week, let's see.
I have a paper presentation in JCDL 15 next week and need to prepare that. I will release this ticket. What I have done in this ticket is in PR https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/807
Thanks for the work so far!
Yinlin Chen, please merge https://github.com/yinlinchen/fcrepo4/pull/5 to complete this ticket.

A. Soroka: I see that Yinlin Chen just merged your PR: https://github.com/yinlinchen/fcrepo4/pull/5
You probably saw my comment that just preceded the merge. Thoughts?

The commits in Yinlin Chen's PR-807 where mixed with non-ticket related commits which made in difficult to rebase on master. Therefore, I re-implemented the relevant commits (with some updates) in a new PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/827

Note, PR-827 should not be committed until the related ticket is closed:
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1552
We are waiting on Unknown to close FCREPO-1552 Closed , right?
Yes, although you are encouraged to review this ticket in preparation for Unknown's greenlight.

A. Soroka, your code review comments have been addressed as a follow-on commit to PR-827.
p.s. When the time comes for merging this with the master branch, the commits on PR-827 should be squashed.
FCREPO-1552 Closed has been closed, so feel free to proceed on this ticket
What are the relevant PRs for this? I've lost track...
The original PR was: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/807, but this has been superseded by https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/827
